gregulvexpansion.item.cats_whisker_detec: A purified galena crystal with a fine red alloy whisk — historically the first semiconductor device.
gregulvexpansion.item.ulv_electric_motor: A crude 8 EU motor. The common prerequisite of every ULV machine and generator.
gregulvexpansion.item.wood_crank.tooltip: A detachable crank. Right-click a hand-crank dynamo to install; wrench to detach.
gregulvexpansion.machine.hand_crank_dyna: Right-click with a wooden crank (AE2's crank works too) to reinstall; wrench to detach.
Your first power source: right-click to crank it. No fuel, no steam, no prerequisites.
Buffer: 480 EU. Each crank adds 24 EU (0.5 s cooldown); outputs 8 EU/t · 1 A on every side.
gregulvexpansion.machine.lead_acid_batte: Overvoltage from an LV+ network trips its fuse and locks it; unsneaking wrench click resets it.
A wall-mounted battery: 24,000 EU of self-contained storage. Wire any side — 8 EU/t · 1 A in and out.
No battery slots (use the upstream charging station for that); no self-discharge when idle.
gregulvexpansion.machine.lead_chamber.to: A no-electricity multiblock that makes sulfuric acid with steam — 1850s industry at its finest.
Recipe: 2 sulfur dust + 500 mB water + steam -> 500 mB sulfuric acid in 40 s. Needs a fluid input hatch on top, plus item input, fluid input and fluid output hatches on the walls.
Far slower than LV chemical reactors — an off-grid backup, not a competitor.
gregulvexpansion.machine.primitive_elect: Lesson one of electric chemistry: electrolysis at 8 EU/t — water in, hydrogen and oxygen out.
Runs only the hand-picked ULV reaction whitelist; buffer 240 EU. Its rectifier bridge is a pair of cat's-whisker detectors.
gregulvexpansion.machine.redstone_genera: The first automatable fuel generator: feed it redstone dust (1,200 EU) or redstone blocks (10,800 EU) and it burns steadily at 8 EU/t · 1 A.
Stack units to scale up — industrial scale belongs to LV combustion generators.
gregulvexpansion.machine.thermoelectric_: Paste it against a heat source (lava, fire, torches) and it quietly produces 1-5 EU/t. Water or ice on any other face boosts the output.
Maintenance-free but capped at 8 EU/t · 1 A — for a real power grid, move on to redstone fuel cells.
gregulvexpansion.machine.ulv_bender.tool: Rolls one ingot into one plate at 8 EU/t — a 50% yield boost over the forge hammer's 3-ingots-for-2-plates.
Runs a hand-picked subset only (red alloy, copper, iron, tin, lead, zinc).
gregulvexpansion.machine.ulv_chemical_re: Electric chemistry step two: the sulfur oxidation chain — sulfur + oxygen into sulfuric acid at 8 EU/t, four times faster than the lead chamber.
Needs oxygen from your electrolyzer. 240 EU buffer.
gregulvexpansion.machine.ulv_cutter.tool: A motor-driven saw blade for basic cutting: rods into bolts, long rods into rods, blocks into plates.
Wrought-iron blade (no precision work). Runs a hand-picked subset only — no wafers, no gem cutting.
gregulvexpansion.machine.ulv_fluid_solid: Freezes fluids into shapes with reusable molds: water into snow, lava into obsidian.
Runs a hand-picked subset only. 240 EU buffer.
gregulvexpansion.machine.ulv_lathe.toolt: Turns bolts into screws and stripped logs into long wood rods (plus a dust bonus) — the screw supply for your conveyors and pumps.
Runs a hand-picked subset only. 240 EU buffer, like every other ULV machine.
gregulvexpansion.machine.ulv_wire_mill.t: Draws metal ingots into single wires at 8 EU/t — twice as slow as the LV wiremill, half the energy.
Runs a hand-picked subset only (red alloy, copper, iron, tin, lead, zinc).
